data.title: 加藤惠 · 坡道上的白色贝雷帽·「那个……你刚才是在叫我吗」
data.description: 【春日午后·樱花坡道】春日下午的樱花坡道，白色连衣裙与贝雷帽。惠单手压住被风吹起的帽檐，另一只手提纸袋，回头时只有很浅的笑。粉色樱花瓣在和煦的春风中漫天飞舞，阳光透过树隙洒在白裙裙摆上，开启了命中注定的邂逅。
data.action: 单手轻按白色贝雷帽回眸浅笑，白裙随风轻扬，手提纸袋
data.lighting: 柔和金色的春日午后逆光与树影斑驳
data.camera: medium shot, looking back over shoulder, cherry blossom bokeh
data.promptProse: On the cherry-blossom slope, Megumi Kato steadies her white beret with one hand and carries a paper bag in the other. She looks back with a slight smile beneath her short brown bob, the puff-sleeved white dress moving in the spring wind. The medium view follows the rising road between flowering trees. Soft afternoon backlight rims hat and hair, while leaf-filtered golden patches drift across the skirt and paving.
